term.label: homologous_chromosome_recognition_and_pairing_locus

definition.text: A chromosomal locus where complementary lncRNA and associated proteins accumulate at the corresponding lncRNA gene loci to tether homologous chromosome during chromosome pairing at meiosis I.

comments: Added as per request by Val Wood GitHub issue #483 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/483)
